newsitem.title: JAPAN: KDD affiliate to launch Internet phone service.
newsitem.headline: KDD affiliate to launch Internet phone service.

text.p: Japan's Rimnet Corp, partly owned by international phone carrier Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co (KDD), will start offering cut-rate international phone service over the Internet in August, a Rimnet spokesman said.
Rimnet, an Internet access provider, will charge 90 yen for a three-minute call to the United States, compared with KDD's 450 yen, he said. Rimnet has about 30,000 members at present.
KDD owns about a 20 percent stake in Rimnet.
Rimnet will be the first to offer Internet-based international phone service in Japan, following Tokyo's planned deregulation on such services in August.
